commits.comment: MRV2 下优化 ACL Graph 重放的同步方式。原实现为修复 async-scheduling 下 ACL graph hang（#4233）引入了设备级同步（全局 barrier），虽然避免了参数更新流与 graph replay 流的竞争，但带来不必要的全局同步开销。本次将全图参数更新流（update_stream）的所有权从 NPUModelRunner 转移到 ModelAclGraphManager，并通过 update_stream.wait_stream(torch.npu.current_stream()) 让更新流仅等待当前 graph replay 流已提交的工作，从而在保持 replay/update 顺序的前提下避免整设备同步。修改幅度小，但涉及流同步语义，需在 NPU 上重点验证 async-scheduling + full graph 场景无 hang 且无性能回退。

commits.message:
[BugFix][MRV2] Avoid global synchronization for ACL graph replay (#12944)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR refines the synchronization introduced for the async-scheduling
ACL graph hang described in #4233.

The hang occurs when the parameter-update stream records the current
iteration event before the previous graph replay has completed. A
device-wide synchronization prevents the race, but also introduces an
unnecessary global barrier.

This change:

- moves ownership of the full-graph parameter update stream from
`NPUModelRunner` to `ModelAclGraphManager`;
- makes the update stream wait for work already submitted to the current
graph replay stream;
- preserves the required replay/update ordering without synchronizing
the entire NPU device.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No.

### How was this patch tested?

None.

commits.message:
[Kernel][Feature] Add AscendC and Triton sparse attention support for MiniMax M3 (#12833)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR adds the sparse-attention operators required by MiniMax M3 on
Ascend （copy from
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12448）:

- Adds the AscendC `SparseAttentionScore` operator, including host
registration, tiling, kernels for supported architectures, build
integration, Torch bindings, and FP16/BF16 reference tests.
- Adds MiniMax M3 Triton kernels for index scoring, top-k selection,
decode processing, and block-sparse GQA attention.
- Adds an NPU adapter that invokes
`torch.ops._C_ascend.npu_sparse_attention_score`.
- Supports sparse-attention prefill and decode paths, including FP8
KV-cache handling in the Triton implementation.
- Adds a one-card correctness test covering the Triton and torch_npu
backends.
- Registers the MiniMax M3 test group in the CI test configuration.

These changes provide the native AscendC and Triton building blocks
needed to execute MiniMax M3 sparse attention efficiently on Ascend
hardware.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. This PR introduces MiniMax M3 sparse-attention execution support
through AscendC and Triton implementations. It does not change an
existing public CLI or API.

### How was this patch tested?

The following tests were added:

- FP16 tests for the AscendC sparse-attention operator:
  `csrc/attention/sparse_attention_score/tests/test_fp16.py`
- BF16 tests for the AscendC sparse-attention operator:
  `csrc/attention/sparse_attention_score/tests/test_bf16.py`
- One-card MiniMax M3 correctness tests covering index operations and
Triton/torch_npu sparse-attention backends:
  `tests/e2e/pull_request/one_card/test_minimax_m3_sparse_attn.py`

commits.message: [CI] Prebuild missing CSRC caches on CPU runners for PR tests (#12279) ### What this PR does / why we need it? This PR moves csrc compilation out of NPU test jobs and builds missing csrc caches on CPU runners instead. Previously, NPU jobs could spend significant time compiling the same custom kernels. Cache creation and cache consumption could also use different source snapshots, causing identical-looking PR runs to miss an existing cache and rebuild it. The new workflow: - resolves the csrc cache targets required by selected NPU runners; - calculates the cache hash from a fixed source snapshot; - looks up the required caches before starting NPU jobs; - builds only missing caches on CPU runners; - requires NPU jobs to restore the cache and installs the package with `COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS=0`; - prints each target's cache hit or miss in its corresponding GitHub Actions step. #### Comparison chart before and after modification #### NPU runner to csrc cache target mapping ```text A2 ARM64 runners ├─ linux-aarch64-a2b3-1 ├─ linux-aarch64-a2b3-2 └─ linux-aarch64-a2b3-4 │ └─ a2-arm64-ubuntu A3 ARM64 runners ├─ linux-aarch64-a3-2 ├─ linux-aarch64-a3-4 └─ linux-aarch64-a3-8 │ └─ a3-arm64-ubuntu 310P ARM64 runners ├─ linux-aarch64-310p-1 ├─ linux-aarch64-310p-2 └─ linux-aarch64-310p-4 │ └─ 310p-arm64-ubuntu ... ``` #### PR and `/e2e` workflow ```text PR ready label / /e2e command │ ▼ Resolve the fixed source snapshot ├─ source repository and ref ├─ fixed base SHA └─ rebase the source onto that base │ ▼ Select tests ├─ selected test groups ├─ required NPU runners └─ deduplicated csrc cache target IDs │ ▼ Ensure csrc caches ├─ calculate the tracked-source manifest hash ├─ lookup a2-arm64-ubuntu ├─ lookup a3-arm64-ubuntu ├─ lookup 310p-arm64-ubuntu ├─ print the hit/miss result for each lookup step └─ collect missing targets │ ├─ no missing targets │ └─ start NPU tests │ └─ missing targets └─ build csrc caches on CPU runners └─ save caches └─ start NPU tests ``` #### Cache production and consumption ```text Fixed source snapshot └─ git ls-files -s -- csrc setup.py CMakeLists.txt cmake │ ▼ csrc source hash │ ├─ target architecture ├─ CANN image tag └─ cache format version │ ▼ vllm-ascend-build-v2--- │ ▼ NPU test job ├─ restore the required cache ├─ build cache when miss(remove after stabilization) ├─ COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS=0 uv pip install -e . └─ run selected tests ``` ### Main changes - Add `_build_csrc_cache.yaml` as the reusable CPU csrc build workflow. - Add `_ensure_csrc_cache.yaml` to look up required caches and build missing targets. - Add a centralized csrc target configuration and resolver under `.github/workflows/scripts/`. - Map NPU runner labels to their corresponding csrc cache targets. - Extend test selection to output deduplicated `csrc_cache_target_ids`. - Use the reusable cache workflows from: - PR tests; - `/e2e` command tests; - scheduled test coverage; - estimated-time updates; - main-to-main tests; - upstream E2E tests; - image build and push cache workflows. - Upgrade the cache key to the `v2` format. - Make csrc cache restore mandatory for NPU jobs with `fail-on-cache-miss: true`. - Use the same fixed base snapshot for test selection, cache creation, and cache consumption. - Checkout and update submodules recursively where source preparation requires them. - Replace repository-name-specific `safe.directory` paths with `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE`. - Add `set -euo pipefail`, Git error handling, and an empty-manifest check to prevent silently generating the empty-input hash. - Standardize workflow shells with `bash -el {0}` where applicable. ### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change? commits.message:
[Performance] Optimize AscendStore key construction and miss path (#12814)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This supersedes #12136 and adapts the AscendStore key-construction and
KVPool miss-path optimizations to `main` with a smaller, unconditional
implementation.

- Generates serialized non-layerwise keys directly, caches immutable
prefixes, and computes grouped hashes lazily.
- Centralizes token/chunk iteration and removes compatibility wrappers
and duplicated key-building paths.
- Propagates HBM hit tokens through lookup, skips external lookup on a
full HBM hit, and avoids querying or storing the HBM-resident prefix
again.
- Applies hybrid-cache reachable, store, and load masks before key
construction.
- Applies store masks before key construction and pre-shards filtered
keys automatically when applicable.
- Uses asynchronous save by default and removes the global/per-request
wait modes and their request-event lifecycle.
- Removes the environment-variable switches for these optimized paths;
no `LOOKUP_FULL_GUARD` behavior is introduced.
- Keeps the layerwise `PoolKey` transfer path unchanged.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. AscendStore now selects the optimized key construction, mask
handling, pre-sharding, and asynchronous save paths automatically
instead of exposing environment-variable switches. The cache key format
remains unchanged. Because save is asynchronous, a following identical
lookup may race with save visibility.

- 152 targeted AscendStore/Mooncake unit tests passed; 10 existing
deprecated layerwise tests were skipped.
- Repository pre-commit hooks passed, including ruff, codespell, typos,
custom Python checks, and DCO sign-off validation.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- NPU hardware testing was not available locally; CI/NPU validation is
required.

commits.message:
[BugFix][KV Pool] Finalize PP stages and surface backend errors (#11929)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR combines three KV Pool fixes:

- make KV connector finalization rank-aware for PP + MTP/speculative
decoding, so non-last PP ranks finalize after the target forward and
store their rank-local KV layers;
- surface the real exception type and message in AscendStore Mooncake,
Memcache, and Yuanrong put/get error logs while keeping large key
details at debug level;
- explicitly ignore generic PP xfer handshake metadata in AscendStore,
which already handles PP through rank-aware pool keys, so MultiConnector
does not reject valid PP deployments.

The PP/MTP fix incorporates the independently reported and validated
solution from #12743. Its author, `yuxingcyx`, is credited as a
co-author on the fix commit. The backend logging changes come from
#11403.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. PP + MTP/speculative decoding + KV Pool stores KV cache data from
every PP stage and completes delayed block freeing. MultiConnector
accepts AscendStore in PP deployments, and backend failures expose
actionable exception details in error logs.

commits.message:
[Feature][MRV2] Support eager for MTP in MRV2. (#12810)

### What this PR does / why we need it?
1. Support eager for MTP in MRV2. The key Ascend-specific piece is
`build_wrapper`, which injects `positions` into the **draft** attention
metadata so that MLA draft tokens receive correct RoPE.
2. With `MTP=3 and MLA` enabled, if` DP > 1`, idle worker processes
create a dummy batch just to keep things in sync. In this setup,
multi-token batches go straight to the MLA decoding path. The`
execute_dummy_batch` method grabs the token count using
`getattr(self.model_runner, "uniform_decode_query_len", 1) `and runs
`self.model_runner._dummy_run(num_tokens, uniform_decode=True).` But
here's the catch: `asdict()` in `make_dummy() `drops Ascend-specific
fields, leaving attn_state as None. Because of this, the MLA operator
takes the wrong branch, giving you a `block_table` shape mismatch error.
3. VLLM used `AutoRegressiveSpeculator` as the base class for Eagle and
MTP. vLLM-Ascend needs to consider this design and implement the
corresponding refactoring. The reusable parts of MTP in eagle's
`speculator.py` should be refactored into
`autoregressive/speculator.py`.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
No

commits.comment: 为 Qwen3.5 dspark 推测解码添加支持，并同步 vLLM 的 reorder batch threshold 计算方式。包含两处改动：(1) AscendGDNAttentionMetadataBuilder 中把 reorder_batch_threshold 的识别从仅 dflash 扩展到 dspark——dflash 阈值取 1 + num_spec（含 base token），dspark 阈值取 num_spec；(2) 删除 NPUModelRunner.calculate_reorder_batch_threshold 中不同 attention 后端阈值不一致即抛 ValueError 的严格校验，以解决 dspark + 标准 attention 组混布时（GDN 分支阈值 1+2N vs 普通分支 1+N）初始化失败的问题。属于有意的约束放宽。潜在风险：移除该校验后，若未来多个后端的 reorder 语义真正不兼容，将不再有显式报错，可能产生不易察觉的 batch 重排错误，建议在测试/文档中明确这一前置假设。

commits.message:
[feature] Support dspark speculative method and synchronize reorder batch threshold calculation with vLLM (#12662)

What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR adds support for the Qwen3.5 dspark speculative decoding method
on Ascend NPUs. Two changes are required:

1. vllm_ascend/ops/gdn_attn_builder.py —
AscendGDNAttentionMetadataBuilder previously only recognized
speculative_config.method == "dflash" when adjusting
reorder_batch_threshold. dspark shares the same speculative-decoding
batch-layout requirements as dflash (both need reorder_batch_threshold =
1 + num_speculative_tokens), so we extend the check to method in
("dflash", "dspark"). Without this, dspark runs fall back to the default
threshold and speculative decoding produces incorrect batch reordering.
2. vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py —
NPUModelRunner.calculate_reorder_batch_threshold used to raise
ValueError when different attention backends reported different
reorder_batch_threshold values. This became a problem once dspark
speculative decoding was enabled alongside standard attention groups
(e.g. GDN speculative branch requests threshold = 1 + 2 * N, while the
normal-speculative attention group keeps 1 + N), causing model
initialization to fail before any request is served.
 
- Fixes # (Qwen3.5-35B dspark speculative decoding cannot be launched on
NPU)
Without this PR, it will raise error "ValueError: Attention backend
reorders decodes with threshold 15 but other backend uses threshold 8"
when you try to launch qwen3.5 dspark serve.

commits.comment: 为 CompressAttentionManager 补充 allocate_external_computed_blocks 方法以适配上游最新 kv_cache_manager 接口。PD 分离场景下 D 节点需要通过该方法为外部已计算 tokens 分配 KV block；若不考虑 compress_ratio，基类会按未压缩的 token 数分配 block_id（例如 compress_ratio=4 时约 104 token 分配 4 块），与压缩后的 block_table 行宽不匹配，触发 'could not broadcast (4,) into (2,)' 崩溃。该实现按 compress_ratio 缩放本地/外部 computed tokens 后再调用父类，与 allocate_new_blocks / allocate_new_computed_blocks 的处理保持一致。属于 PD + P/D KV pool + Compress-MLA 场景的关键 bugfix。

test_impact.reason: 新增 allocate_external_computed_blocks override 引入了 compress_ratio 缩放逻辑，属于 PD + Compress-MLA 场景的关键修复，需要单元测试覆盖外部 block 分配数量与 block_table 行宽匹配，防止回归。

### What this PR does / why we need it?
In the latest VLLM upstream, the ·allocate_external_computed_blocks·
method is added to ·kv_cache_manager· to allocate `kvcacheblocks` for
the D node with PD. This PR implements this method for
CompressAttnManager, considering the `compress_ratio` during allocating
blocks.

No.

By CI.

commits.comment: 这是一个大规模架构重构（RFC #12622，1/N）：从 Model Runner V1 中完全移除 PCP（Prefill Context Parallelism）支持，只保留 DCP（Decode Context Parallelism）。核心变化包括：删除 pcp_utils.py（2403 行），新增 dcp_utils.py（DCPManager）；attention 系列从 'CP 统一处理' 拆分为 DCP 专用实现（AscendAttentionDCPImpl、AscendMlaDCPImpl、AscendSFADCPImpl），并通过 DCPImplMixin / DCPMetadataBuilderMixin / metadata_cls 扩展点共享 DCP 公共逻辑；AscendMetadata 基类去掉 PCP 相关字段（prefill/decode_meta/num_actual_tokens_pcp_padded），改为由子类扩展；platform 校验改为 MRV1 直接拒绝 prefill_context_parallel_size > 1，v2 runner 暂缓校验；KV cache block size 相关计算全部从 dcp*pcp 改为仅 dcp；spec decode 的 PCP 拆分逻辑（含 MM 预处理、mrope 重映射、PCP 隐藏状态恢复等）被整体删除；patch 层对 pcp_world_size 统一按 1 处理。测试同步大规模重写（60+ 文件）。这是高风险变更：PCP 在 MRV1 中被明确禁用，依赖 PCP 的能力（如 PCP+DP、PCP+MM）将直接报错；同时如此大规模删除/重构容易引入 DCP 路径的回归，需要重点验证 DCP-only 的 decode/prefill、spec decode 与 310P 场景。

test_impact.reason: 本次 commit 已包含 60+ 测试文件的同步修改，但 PCP 移除后 DCP-only 路径、新建 DCPManager、DCP metadata builder/impl mixin、platform 对 PCP 的拒绝逻辑等都需要持续测试看护；同时大量删除的 PCP 测试意味着对应能力不再被测试覆盖，需要确认是否有用户依赖被误删。
